title: On Cross-Layer Interactions of QUIC, Encrypted DNS and HTTP/3: Design, Evaluation and Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'Web Privacy By Design' and extensively evaluates the privacy implications and benefits of different protocols for encrypted communication, including discussions on user trust, data centralization, and policy (e.g., Digital Services Act). This goes beyond a mere 'ethical considerations' section to form a core component of the design and evaluation.
